_comment: Description and badge transcribed from the in-game Custom Search screen with this mode selected, captured 2026-08-05 (Steam capture 20260805231917).
name: Conquest

description.text: Fight to control objectives in a large-scale battle, wearing down the enemy until one side remains.

_art_note: Art is the little badge the game prints beside GAME MODE on the Custom Search screen, not a scene, so it renders at icon size rather than filling the art column. Cut from the same capture as the description.
_tag_deny_note: 1.3.2.0 files thirteen Portal SDK bullets under the heading "ViperStudiosAndy Portal Custom Conquest Template", and heading inheritance put all of them on this page: dirt bikes, night vision toggles, thanks to Mancour. That is a community Portal template that happens to be named after the mode, not the mode. Masking the phrase drops the block while leaving the Conquest Assault lines, which name Conquest in their own text and are a real variant of it.
